test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23rd November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A can complete a work in 25 days and B can complete it in 30 days. If they work on it together for 5 days, then the fraction of the work that is left will be:
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A to complete work = 25 days

Time taken by B to complete work = 30 days

**Formula used:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time taken

**Calculation:**

LCM of 25 and 30 = 150 i.e total work

Efficiency of A = 150/25 = 6 units/day

Efficiency of B = 150/30 = 5 units/day

Effective efficiency = 6 + 5 = 11 units/day

Total work complete = 5 × 11 = 55 units

Remaining 150 - 55 = 95 units

Fraction of the work left = 95/150 = 19/30

**∴ The fraction of the work that is left will be 19/30.**
